half.label: Harbor working fishing boat
half.coordinate_system: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y
half.origin: XY grid center, bottom grid plane Z=0
notes: Original curved occupied hull with an open timber deck, forward wheelhouse, stern winch and lifting frame, real fenders and mooring fittings.
Rear working deck, boarding ladder, rudder and propeller are authored geometry. Glazing uses opaque flat palette colors.
All ropes are static voxel beams; no sailing, water, rigging or machinery animation is included.
half.half_method: 2x2x2 nonempty majority; color index breaks ties; optional documented detail correction
half.uv: No texture UV required: per-face solid palette PBR materials

half.label: Lantern harbor lighthouse
half.coordinate_system: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y
half.origin: XY grid center, bottom grid plane Z=0
notes: Stepped tapered masonry tower, brick identification band, front arch and stairs, gallery balustrade, separate eight-post lantern structure and central lamp.
Lantern bays are deliberately open so the actual frame and lamp remain readable in both voxel sizes; no optical beam or glass transmission simulation is claimed.
Rear service door and louvered vent are modeled. Static geometry only.
half.half_method: 2x2x2 nonempty majority; color index breaks ties; optional documented detail correction

half.label: Barrel-roof harbor warehouse
half.coordinate_system: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y
half.origin: XY grid center, bottom grid plane Z=0
notes: Original hollow cargo hall with a curved barrel roof, skylights, open front and side sliding cargo doors, rails, interior cargo, attached loading deck and access stairs.

Rear loading shutter, personnel access and rain downpipes are visible geometry. Door and roof glass colors are opaque.

half.label: Four-leg harbor cargo crane
half.coordinate_system: X right, Y back, Z up; front -Y
half.origin: XY grid center, bottom grid plane Z=0
notes: Stout four-legged splayed base, circular slew bearing, glazed cab, rear counterweight and access door, real transverse winch, two-sided open lattice boom.
Two suspension cables connect a separate orange sheave block to the boom tip; the hanging hook has an authored opening and is not a decal.
Ladder, guard rails and mechanical details are deliberately thick for native half-resolution reduction. Static machinery only.
half.half_method: 2x2x2 nonempty majority; color index breaks ties; optional documented detail correction
